ينتجعا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَجِعَا (yantajiʕā) /jan.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# يُنْتَجَعَا (yuntajaʕā) /jun.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
